title: Revert "Add support for ASGI `pathsend` extension"
description:
This reverts #2435.
Superseed #2616, as discussed in [comments](https://github.com/encode/starlette/pull/2616#discussion_r1686260072).

# Checklist

- [X] I understand that this PR may be closed in case there was no previous discussion. (This doesn't apply to typos!)
- [X] I've added a test for each change that was introduced, and I tried as much as possible to make a single atomic change.
- [ ] I've updated the documentation accordingly.
patch_diff:
diff --git a/starlette/responses.py b/starlette/responses.py
index bd66f897e..1f41c23d4 100644
--- a/starlette/responses.py
+++ b/starlette/responses.py
@@ -341,8 +341,6 @@ async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
         )
         if scope["method"].upper() == "HEAD":
             await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"", "more_body": False})
-        elif "extensions" in scope and "http.response.pathsend" in scope["extensions"]:
-            await send({"type": "http.response.pathsend", "path": str(self.path)})
         else:
             async with await anyio.open_file(self.path, mode="rb") as file:
                 more_body = True
